need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio does not provide a managed Xero OAuth app, so you must register your own and give Composio its client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Xero Developer plan and card
prerequisites.detail: Pricing is per app by plan, and moving from Starter to Core needs a registered credit card.

prerequisites.title: Beta customers before certification
prerequisites.detail: Beta customers must be non-demo Xero organisations with API calls in the last 30 days.

steps.title: Register Xero app and redirect URI
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal, create the app, and add the redirect URI copied from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for toolkit xero with your client ID, secret and granular scopes via Composio's API.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Pick a plan for expected connections
steps.detail: Choose a tier covering your customer count and add a payment card.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare draft answers on authentication, encryption, personnel security and audit logging for you to verify.
steps.done_when: Draft is ready for your review.

steps.title: Submit assessment and applications
steps.detail: Submit the assessment and, for the listing, the partner program application and listing content.

steps.title: Wait for Xero review
steps.detail: Xero reviews answers and emails the result; failure brings a remediation report.

traps.title: Exceeding either rate limit returns an HTTP 429 (too
traps.detail: Exceeding either rate limit returns an HTTP 429 (too many requests) response.

traps.title: Bulk Connections lets a single user connect multiple Xero
traps.detail: Bulk Connections lets a single user connect multiple Xero organisations to the app in one OAuth 2.0 authorisation flow; the page does not say whether an admin is needed.

traps.title: Connection caps are hard plan limits
traps.detail: Starter allows 5 connections and Core 50; connection counts cannot be shared between your apps.

traps.title: Rate limits hit AI agents quickly
traps.detail: Per organisation: 5 calls at once, 60 per minute, 5000 per day. The app overall is capped at 10,000 per minute.

traps.title: New apps get only granular scopes
traps.detail: Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 get granular scopes only, and moving users to them needs explicit re-consent.

traps.title: Redirect URIs must be exact
traps.detail: No wildcards, absolute URIs only, and at most 50 per app.

traps.title: Beta customer gate precedes certification
traps.detail: You need 10 active non-demo organisations before submitting certification.

traps.title: Annual repeat
traps.detail: The assessment is yearly and a missed recertification can remove your listing.

blockers.what_it_means: You exceeded a per-organisation or app-wide rate limit.
blockers.agent_can_help: Add concurrency limits and backoff to the agent's Xero calls.

evidence.question: C1
evidence.quote: Add your own OAuth app only for toolkits where the provider consent screen must show your brand.
evidence.answer: Composio says to add your own OAuth app only for toolkits where the provider consent screen must show your brand.

evidence.question: G1
evidence.quote: No new apps will be added to Xero App Store Subscriptions (XASS) or Commercial Billing (CB) models beginning 4 December, 2025.
evidence.answer: No new apps can be added to the legacy Xero App Store Subscriptions or Commercial Billing models from 4 December 2025.

evidence.question: G1
evidence.quote: we are retiring our current revenue share model (comprising Xero App Store Subscriptions and Commercial Billing) and introducing five plans: Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, Enterprise.
evidence.answer: Xero is retiring its current revenue share model (App Store Subscriptions and Commercial Billing) in favour of five plans: Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, Enterprise.

evidence.question: G1
evidence.quote: Apps created on or after 2 March, 2026 will move directly to the new pricing model.
evidence.answer: Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 move directly to the new pricing model.

evidence.question: G2
evidence.quote: Xero App Store listing | Not Included | Not Included | Optional | Optional | Required |
evidence.answer: Xero App Store listing is not included in Starter or Core, optional for Plus and Advanced, and required for Enterprise.

evidence.question: G2
evidence.quote: App Certification
evidence.answer: App Certification is a listed prerequisite for the Plus, Advanced and Enterprise plans (the page does not describe what it involves).

evidence.question: G2
evidence.quote: Security Assessment (initial and annual)
evidence.answer: A Security Assessment (initial and annual) is a listed prerequisite for the Advanced and Enterprise plans.

evidence.question: G2
evidence.quote: Connections: customer or tenants connected to your app via a valid OAuth connection
evidence.answer: Connections are customers or tenants connected to the app via a valid OAuth connection.

evidence.question: G3
evidence.quote: Bulk connections (require security assessment and use case approval) | Not Included | Not Included | Not Included | | |
evidence.answer: The Bulk connections premium feature requires a security assessment and use case approval, and is not included in Starter, Core or Plus.

evidence.question: G3
evidence.quote: Journal endpoint (require security assessment and use case approval) | Not Included | Not Included | Not Included | | |
evidence.answer: The Journal endpoint premium feature requires a security assessment and use case approval, and is not included in Starter, Core or Plus.

evidence.question: G3
evidence.quote: XPM API (require security assessment and use case approval) | Not Included | Not Included | Not Included | | |
evidence.answer: The XPM API premium feature requires a security assessment and use case approval, and is not included in Starter, Core or Plus.

evidence.question: G5
evidence.quote: Connections (maximum) | 5 | 50 | 1000 | 10,000 | No limit |
evidence.answer: The connection maximum is 5 for Starter, 50 for Core, 1000 for Plus, 10,000 for Advanced, and no limit for Enterprise.

evidence.question: G5
evidence.quote: Rate Limits | 1000 per day per org | 5000 per day per org | 5000 per day per org | 5000 per day per org | 5000 per day per org |
evidence.answer: Rate limits are 1000 per day per org on Starter and 5000 per day per org on Core, Plus, Advanced and Enterprise.

evidence.question: G5
evidence.quote: Monthly Xero API usage (Egress GBs)* | n/a | 10 GBs | 50 GBs | 250 GBs | Volume on Application |
evidence.answer: Monthly egress allotments are 10 GBs (Core), 50 GBs (Plus), 250 GBs (Advanced), volume on application (Enterprise); Starter has none (n/a).

evidence.question: G5
evidence.quote: These reset on the first of the calendar month (using UTC timezone), allowing you a new allotment, as long as you have an active payment method on file with Xero Developer.
evidence.answer: Monthly allotments reset on the first of the calendar month (UTC), provided an active payment method is on file with Xero Developer.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: App pricing is a flat monthly fee based on plan and includes a set allotment of data consumption via the Xero APIs. Additional data consumption is available at additional cost.
evidence.answer: App pricing is a flat monthly fee based on plan, including a set allotment of API data consumption; extra consumption costs more.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: Monthly Tier Fee | No charge | $35 AUD | $245 AUD | $1445 AUD | Price on Application |
evidence.answer: Monthly tier fees are no charge (Starter), 35 AUD (Core), 245 AUD (Plus), 1445 AUD (Advanced), and price on application (Enterprise).

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: Overage Xero API usage egress pricing (per GB) | n/a | $2.40 AUD | $2.40 AUD | $2.40 AUD | Price on Application |
evidence.answer: Overage egress usage costs $2.40 AUD per GB on Core, Plus and Advanced; price on application for Enterprise.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: Monthly Xero API usage (Ingress GBs) | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
evidence.answer: Ingress usage is unlimited on every plan.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: *We exclude the organisation endpoint from this usage allotment
evidence.answer: The organisation endpoint is excluded from the egress allotment.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: Payments are accepted via registered credit card. Your card details will be required when moving from the Starter to the Core plan.
evidence.answer: Payments are made by registered credit card, and card details are required when moving from Starter to Core.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: Payments will occur (via the registered credit card) on the first of the following month, after the last billing month.
evidence.answer: Payments occur via the registered credit card on the first of the month following the billed month.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: Pricing is tax exclusive
evidence.answer: Pricing is stated tax exclusive.

evidence.question: G7
evidence.quote: Connection count and API data consumption via the Xero API is measured and priced at the app level. Apps cannot share connection counts or API volume used, even if they are from the same developer.
evidence.answer: Connections and API usage are measured and priced per app, and apps cannot share connection counts or API volume, even within the same developer.

evidence.question: G8
evidence.quote: The Bulk Connections feature that allows a single user to connect multiple Xero organisations (tenants) to your app in one single OAuth 2.0 authorisation flow.
evidence.answer: Bulk Connections lets a single user connect multiple Xero organisations to the app in one OAuth 2.0 authorisation flow; the page does not say whether an admin is needed.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: Eligible for Growth and App Awards Programs (requires Xero App Store listing) | Not Included | Not Included | | | |
evidence.answer: Eligibility for Growth and App Awards Programs requires a Xero App Store listing.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: Eligible to sponsor Xero events: Xerocon, regional roadshows, educational events (requires Xero App Store listing)
evidence.answer: Eligibility to sponsor Xero events requires a Xero App Store listing.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: Eligible for Xero App Store promotional merchandising, access to in product placements and promotion in Xero channels, content and campaigns (requires Xero App Store listing)
evidence.answer: Eligibility for Xero App Store promotional merchandising, in-product placements and promotion requires a Xero App Store listing.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: Apps cannot share connection counts or API volume used, even if they are from the same developer.
evidence.answer: Connection counts and API volume cannot be shared between apps, even from the same developer.

evidence.question: G4
evidence.quote: The broad accounting.transactions scope is now split into more specific scopes as detailed below:
evidence.answer: The broad accounting.transactions scope is replaced by granular scopes: accounting.invoices, accounting.payments, accounting.banktransactions, accounting.manualjournals, and accounting.classicexpenses, each with a read-only variant.

evidence.question: G4
evidence.quote: The broad accounting.reports.read scope is now split into scopes for each report type as detailed below:
evidence.answer: The broad accounting.reports.read scope is split into per-report scopes, such as accounting.reports.profitandloss.read, accounting.reports.balancesheet.read and accounting.reports.trialbalance.read.

evidence.question: G4
evidence.quote: Apps created after 2 March 2026, will automatically have the new granular scopes.
evidence.answer: Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 receive only the granular scopes; apps created earlier must migrate from broad scopes by September 2027.

evidence.question: G4
evidence.quote: Because you are requesting a different set of permissions, the user must provide explicit consent for the granular scopes.
evidence.answer: Moving to granular scopes requires each end user to explicitly re-consent; scopes cannot be silently migrated.

evidence.question: R1
evidence.quote: You will now be required to onboard 10 beta customers prior to submitting your application via your app in the developer centre.
evidence.answer: Xero's official devblog (May 2025) says new apps must onboard 10 beta customers before they can submit the App Store certification application, a gate that comes before any review.

evidence.question: R1
evidence.quote: Be actively using your Xero integration i.e. API calls have been made to their tenant in the last 30 days
evidence.answer: A beta customer counts only if it is a non-demo Xero organisation that has made API calls to its tenant in the last 30 days, which makes the beta gate harder to satisfy in practice.

evidence.question: R1
evidence.quote: Warning: by the time the whole approval process finishes you should have no more than 20 organisations connected with the XERO Integration.
evidence.answer: A third-party Xero partner agency (Maze) warns that an app should stay at or under about 20 connected organisations before approval finishes; this is a report, not an official limit.

evidence.question: R1
evidence.quote: Once the formal review is over; comes the Pilot, this is where you will onboard actual customers to use the XERO Integration.
evidence.answer: Per the Maze partner guide, the sequence is demo, formal review, live pilot with real customers, then landing page and marketplace listing approval.

evidence.question: R1
evidence.quote: If we don’t receive your assessment by this date, your listing may be temporarily removed from the Xero App Store until the process is completed.
evidence.answer: Xero's 2026 annual recertification (assessment due 28 Feb 2026) is recurring; a missed deadline can get a listing temporarily removed from the App Store.
